variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.sub: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement.
variants.body:
The party {party} has walked out of the government. The departure is a change in the governing arrangement, not a complete account of its consequences. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of leaving from assumptions about parliamentary strength or a successor ministry.

There is a principled question beneath every argument about staying in office: what makes cooperation worth sustaining? Our movement should answer it honestly. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.sub: The party {party} has left the colony's government.
variants.body:
The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement. The event raises the question of what parties owe an arrangement they enter. For {target}, responsibility should be considered without pretending that the report supplies the departing party's reasons or the administration's next steps.

There is a principled question beneath every argument about staying in office: what makes cooperation worth sustaining? Our movement should answer it honestly. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.sub: The party {party} has walked out of the government.
variants.body:
The party {party} has left the colony's government. A party has taken that step in {colony}. Its effect on the governing relationship is the subject of this report; judgments of {target} should not depend on an invented dispute, ultimatum or distribution of seats.

There is a principled question beneath every argument about staying in office: what makes cooperation worth sustaining? Our movement should answer it honestly. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
